name: crouch_check
text: A standing person lowers into a deep squat and leans forward to look down closely at the ground. Hands rest above the knees, elbows supported on the thighs. Remain squatting with head tilted downward.

review.notes_zh: 从站立下蹲，双肘靠近膝上，持续弯背低头查看地面；手部向上18厘米约束消除了首版明显手指穿地，最终骨架最低约-1.6厘米。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
